en: The image is a black-and-white photograph of a large house or villa with a steeply pitched roof and decorative woodwork at the front. The word 'HOFESHHEIM' is visible on the side of the building. In the background, there is an industrial complex with a tall smokestack and a few more modest buildings. The area is fenced in the foreground with a lawn and some shrubbery. The photo looks early 20th century, potentially in Central Europe.
